item.text:
{
  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",
  "role": "blind-translation",
  "dossier_sha256": "30dd425bb38a51bcce0cec8d7882d104f2d82d29670a998ee496b4b83703ca4c",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {
      "id": "D001",
      "name": "LocalDef001",
      "meaning": "Maps a real speed c to the matrix A indexed by Fin 1 in both coordinates, with A(i,j)=c.",
      "effect_on_target": "The matrix in the first conjunct is precisely the one-by-one real matrix [c].",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D002",
      "name": "LocalDef002",
      "meaning": "For a real square matrix indexed by Fin m, abbreviates LocalDef006.",
      "effect_on_target": "The first conjunct requires a real eigenbasis for [c], using the definition in D006.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D003",
      "name": "LocalDef003",
      "meaning": "For a real-valued function w of two real variables, abbreviates LocalDef005 w c x t.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires existence of the two partial derivatives at (x,t), satisfying the equation with coefficient c.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D004",
      "name": "LocalDef004",
      "meaning": "For any type E and profile f: R → E, defines w(x,t)=f(x−ct).",
      "effect_on_target": "Specialized to E=R, supplies both the function in the differential equation and the function evaluated at (x+ct,t).",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D005",
      "name": "LocalDef005",
      "meaning": "For q: R → R → E in a real normed vector space E, asserts existence of qt,qx in E such that τ ↦ q(x,τ) has derivative qt at t, ξ ↦ q(ξ,t) has derivative qx at x, and qt+c•qx=0.",
      "effect_on_target": "For w(x,t)=f(x−ct), asserts pointwise existence of real partial derivatives with w_t+c w_x=0.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D006",
      "name": "LocalDef006",
      "meaning": "For a real matrix A indexed by a finite type ι, asserts existence of λ: ι → R and a basis b of the real vector space ι → R, indexed by ι, such that A b(p)=λ(p)•b(p) for every p.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires diagonalizability over R of the one-by-one matrix [c]. It does not require distinct eigenvalues or an orthonormal basis.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D007",
      "name": "LocalDef007",
      "meaning": "Real scalar multiplication is jointly continuous on every real normed vector space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies continuity infrastructure for the derivative predicates in D005; adds no assumption on the profile.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D008",
      "name": "And",
      "meaning": "Logical conjunction.",
      "effect_on_target": "All three principal conclusions hold together, and both conclusions inside the derivative implication hold together.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D009",
      "name": "ContinuousMul.to_continuousSMul",
      "meaning": "Joint continuity of multiplication implies joint continuity of the multiplication action on the same space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides continuous real scalar multiplication for the real derivative predicate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D010",
      "name": "DenselyNormedField.toNontriviallyNormedField",
      "meaning": "Retains the normed field of a densely normed field and supplies nontriviality of its norm.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the nontrivially normed real scalar field required by HasDerivAt.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D011",
      "name": "Eq",
      "meaning": "Equality of two objects of the same type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Expresses exact equality in the eigenvector equations, the zero differential expression, and w(x+ct,t)=f(x).",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D012",
      "name": "HAdd.hAdd",
      "meaning": "Selects the addition operation from a heterogeneous addition instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Here denotes ordinary real addition, including x+ct and qt+c qx.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D013",
      "name": "HMul.hMul",
      "meaning": "Selects the multiplication operation from a heterogeneous multiplication instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Here denotes ordinary real multiplication in ct and related expressions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D014",
      "name": "HSub.hSub",
      "meaning": "Selects the subtraction operation from a heterogeneous subtraction instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Here denotes real subtraction in the profile argument x−ct.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D015",
      "name": "HasDerivAt",
      "meaning": "Asserts that f has derivative f' at x, using the derivative filter with its first point approaching x and its second point fixed at x.",
      "effect_on_target": "For real functions this is the ordinary derivative at a point, with no restriction to a subset or one-sided domain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D016",
      "name": "IsTopologicalRing.toIsTopologicalSemiring",
      "meaning": "Retains the topological semiring properties of a topological ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Contributes to obtaining continuous real multiplication for differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D017",
      "name": "IsTopologicalSemiring.toContinuousMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts joint continuity of multiplication from a topological semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides continuity of real multiplication, hence the continuous scalar action used by HasDerivAt.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D018",
      "name": "LT.lt",
      "meaning": "Selects the strict comparison relation from an LT instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "With the real instance, expresses c>0, t₁<t₂, and strict increase of x+ct.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D019",
      "name": "Nat",
      "meaning": "The natural numbers, including zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the matrix dimension parameter, instantiated to 1.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D020",
      "name": "NonUnitalCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the operations and commutativity of a nonunital commutative ring while forgetting associativity as a required field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides weaker real ring structure for continuity infrastructure; changes no real operation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D021",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying nonunital, not necessarily associative ring structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the topological ring instance chain without adding a mathematical condition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D022",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring",
      "meaning": "Retains addition, multiplication, zero, and distributivity while forgetting additive inverses as required structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the semiring structure used for continuity and matrix-vector multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D023",
      "name": "NonUnitalNormedCommRing.toNonUnitalCommRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the algebraic nonunital commutative ring from its normed version.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the real algebraic structure used to obtain multiplication continuity.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D024",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying nonunital seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Part of the structure chain supplying the usual real seminormed additive group.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D025",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedRing.toSeminormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Retains the norm, additive commutative group, and pseudometric of a nonunital seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the additive and metric structure needed for the real normed-space and derivative instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D026",
      "name": "NontriviallyNormedField.toNormedField",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Keeps the ordinary real field and norm in the derivative infrastructure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D027",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toNonUnitalNormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains a normed commutative ring's additive, multiplicative, and metric data while omitting the unit requirements.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies weaker structure on the same real numbers for topological instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D028",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains ring operations and norm, viewing the metric as a pseudometric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real seminormed ring structure used to construct the derivative's topology and module.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D029",
      "name": "NormedField.toNormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the normed commutative ring underlying a normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects the real normed field to its usual ring and metric structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D030",
      "name": "NormedField.toNormedSpace",
      "meaning": "Regards a normed field as a normed vector space over itself, with scalar action given by multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "The derivative values are real scalars, and real scalar multiplication is ordinary multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D031",
      "name": "NormedSpace.toModule",
      "meaning": "Extracts the module structure underlying a normed space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real-linear structure used in HasDerivAt.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D032",
      "name": "OfNat.ofNat",
      "meaning": "Interprets a natural-number numeral in a type using its numeral instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Interprets 0 as real zero and 1 as the natural matrix dimension.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D033",
      "name": "PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the uniform structure associated with a pseudometric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Helps supply the usual topology on R for derivative limits.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D034",
      "name": "Real",
      "meaning": "The type of real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "All target scalars, coordinates, profile values, and matrix entries are real.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D035",
      "name": "Real.denselyNormedField",
      "meaning": "Equips R with its normed field and the property that norms occur between any two positive real bounds.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the nontrivially normed field needed for real differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D036",
      "name": "Real.instAdd",
      "meaning": "The real addition operation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the meaning of addition in the trajectories and differential equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D037",
      "name": "Real.instAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "The additive commutative group structure on R.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the additive group required for real derivative values.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D038",
      "name": "Real.instLT",
      "meaning": "The usual strict order on R.",
      "effect_on_target": "The positivity and monotonicity claims use strict real inequalities.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D039",
      "name": "Real.instMul",
      "meaning": "The real multiplication operation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the products involving c, time, and real scalar actions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D040",
      "name": "Real.instSub",
      "meaning": "Real subtraction a−b is a+(−b).",
      "effect_on_target": "The moving profile uses the argument x−ct with this sign.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D041",
      "name": "Real.instZero",
      "meaning": "The additive zero of R.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the zero in c>0 and in the differential equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D042",
      "name": "Real.normedCommRing",
      "meaning": "The real commutative ring equipped with its usual norm and compatible metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides compatible real algebra and topology for derivative infrastructure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D043",
      "name": "Real.normedField",
      "meaning": "The real field equipped with its usual multiplicative norm and compatible metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines the scalar field and norm used in real differentiation and normed-space structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D044",
      "name": "Real.pseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "The pseudometric on R defined by d(x,y)=|x−y|, with its associated uniform structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Ensures that derivative limits use the usual real topology.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D045",
      "name": "SeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the operations, seminorm, and pseudometric while dropping unit requirements.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the real seminormed additive group instance; introduces no restriction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D046",
      "name": "SeminormedCommRing.toSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the same real pseudometric through the ring structure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D047",
      "name": "SeminormedRing.toPseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the pseudometric space underlying a seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Contributes the usual real topology to the continuity instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D048",
      "name": "UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the topology associated with a uniform space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the topology in the derivative and scalar-continuity predicates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D049",
      "name": "Zero.toOfNat0",
      "meaning": "Interprets the numeral 0 as the selected zero element.",
      "effect_on_target": "The numeral in 0<c is real additive zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D050",
      "name": "instHAdd",
      "meaning": "Uses an ordinary addition operation as a homogeneous instance of heterogeneous addition.",
      "effect_on_target": "The displayed HAdd expressions are ordinary real sums.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D051",
      "name": "instHMul",
      "meaning": "Uses an ordinary multiplication operation as a homogeneous instance of heterogeneous multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "The displayed HMul expressions are ordinary real products.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D052",
      "name": "instHSub",
      "meaning": "Uses an ordinary subtraction operation as a homogeneous instance of heterogeneous subtraction.",
      "effect_on_target": "The displayed HSub expressions are ordinary real differences.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D053",
      "name": "instIsTopologicalRingReal",
      "meaning": "R with its usual topology is a topological ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies continuity of real multiplication and consequently of its scalar action.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D054",
      "name": "instOfNatNat",
      "meaning": "Interprets a natural-number numeral n in Nat as n itself.",
      "effect_on_target": "The dimension argument is exactly the natural number 1.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D055",
      "name": "Fin",
      "meaning": "Fin n is the type of natural numbers strictly less than n.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fin 1 contains exactly the index 0, so the matrix and eigenbasis index set are nonempty singletons.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D056",
      "name": "Fin.fintype",
      "meaning": "Enumerates every element of Fin n without repetition.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies finite indexing for the matrix-vector product; at n=1 its sum has one term.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D057",
      "name": "Matrix",
      "meaning": "A matrix with row type m, column type n, and entries in α is a function m → n → α.",
      "effect_on_target": "The coefficient matrix is the function assigning c to its sole row-column pair.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D058",
      "name": "Real.normedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "R as an additive commutative group equipped with its usual norm and metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Specializes the general normed-group setting of D005 to real-valued functions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D059",
      "name": "AddCommGroup.toDivisionAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Constructs the subtraction commutative monoid structure of an additive commutative group, preserving subtraction and negation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides inherited additive infrastructure, including the zero used in D005; does not introduce division of derivative values.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D060",
      "name": "AddCommMagma.toAdd",
      "meaning": "Extracts addition from a commutative additive magma.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the inherited addition in qt+c•qx.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D061",
      "name": "AddCommMonoid.toAddCommSemigroup",
      "meaning": "Retains associative commutative addition from an additive commutative monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Part of the inherited addition structure for the derivative equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D062",
      "name": "AddCommSemigroup.toAddCommMagma",
      "meaning": "Retains the addition operation and its commutativity.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects the normed-space additive structure to the addition in D005.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D063",
      "name": "AddMonoid.toAddZeroClass",
      "meaning": "Retains addition, zero, and the left and right additive identity laws.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the additive zero structure used by scalar actions and the equation in D005.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D064",
      "name": "AddZero.toZero",
      "meaning": "Extracts zero from a structure carrying addition and zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "The resulting zero is the same additive zero in the differential equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D065",
      "name": "AddZeroClass.toAddZero",
      "meaning": "Extracts the addition and zero operations from an additive identity structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies inherited zero and addition without changing the equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D066",
      "name": "Algebra.id",
      "meaning": "A commutative semiring is an algebra over itself via the identity map, with scalar action given by multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Real scalar action on real entries is ordinary multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D067",
      "name": "Algebra.toSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts the scalar multiplication operation of an algebra.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real scalar multiplication underlying the eigenvector equations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D068",
      "name": "CommRing.toNonUnitalCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains commutative ring operations and laws while omitting unit requirements.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the algebraic structure for real matrix-vector multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D069",
      "name": "CommSemiring.toSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying semiring of a commutative semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the real module, algebra, and basis structures with unchanged operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D070",
      "name": "DFunLike.coe",
      "meaning": "Coerces a function-like object to its underlying function.",
      "effect_on_target": "Allows a basis to be evaluated at an index to obtain its basis vector.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D071",
      "name": "DistribMulAction.toDistribSMul",
      "meaning": "Retains the scalar action and its preservation of zero and addition from a distributive multiplicative action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the scalar action occurring in qt+c•qx.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D072",
      "name": "DistribSMul.toSMulZeroClass",
      "meaning": "Extracts a scalar action preserving zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Part of the inherited normed-space scalar multiplication in D005.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D073",
      "name": "ENormedAddCommMonoid.toESeminormedAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Retains the extended seminormed additive commutative monoid structure of an extended normed additive commutative monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "An instance path for additive structure; does not introduce extended-real profile or derivative values.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D074",
      "name": "ESeminormedAddCommMonoid.toAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying additive commutative monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies addition and zero inherited from the normed codomain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D075",
      "name": "ESeminormedAddCommMonoid.toESeminormedAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the extended seminormed additive monoid structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Contributes an instance path to the unchanged additive operations of D005.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D076",
      "name": "ESeminormedAddMonoid.toAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying additive monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the addition and zero infrastructure for the differential expression.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D077",
      "name": "Exists",
      "meaning": "Existential quantification over an object satisfying a predicate.",
      "effect_on_target": "Quantifies the eigenvalue family and eigenbasis, and separately the two derivative values at each eligible point.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D078",
      "name": "Fintype",
      "meaning": "A finite enumeration of all elements of a type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the general matrix index set finite; the target uses the singleton Fin 1.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D079",
      "name": "Function.hasSMul",
      "meaning": "Defines scalar multiplication on function spaces pointwise.",
      "effect_on_target": "In an eigenvector equation, (λ•v)(i)=λ v(i).",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D080",
      "name": "HSMul.hSMul",
      "meaning": "Selects the scalar multiplication operation from a heterogeneous scalar-action instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Expresses scaling of eigenvectors and derivative values; for real derivative values it is ordinary multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D081",
      "name": "Matrix.mulVec",
      "meaning": "For matrix M and vector v, defines (Mv)(i) as the dot product of row i with v, namely the finite sum of M(i,j)v(j).",
      "effect_on_target": "For [c], the action sends v(0) to c v(0).",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D082",
      "name": "Module.Basis",
      "meaning": "An indexed module basis: a linearly independent spanning family, equivalently unique finite coordinate representations.",
      "effect_on_target": "The eigenvectors in D006 form a full real basis, rather than merely an arbitrary family satisfying eigenvector equations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D083",
      "name": "Module.Basis.instFunLike",
      "meaning": "Evaluates a basis at i by applying its inverse coordinate representation to the finitely supported coordinate vector equal to 1 at i and 0 elsewhere.",
      "effect_on_target": "The vector b(p) in D006 is the actual p-th basis vector.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D084",
      "name": "Module.toDistribMulAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts the distributive scalar action from a module.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the module scalar action used in the differential equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D085",
      "name": "NegZeroClass.toZero",
      "meaning": "Extracts zero from a structure with negation fixing zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the same additive zero at the right side of D005.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D086",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "An additive commutative group with a norm and compatible metric d(x,y)=‖x−y‖.",
      "effect_on_target": "The generic derivative equation requires this codomain structure; the target specializes it to R and does not assume completeness.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D087",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup.toAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive commutative group underlying a normed additive commutative group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the additive group needed for derivative values in D005.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
